journey.name: EXC-07: 非法输入与边界值场景
journey.description: 验证用户在网关地址栏输入非 HTTPS 协议、畸形域名、特殊注入字符，或者输入空账号、空密码时，输入校验立即触发拦截，给出明确的错误高亮和辅助说明，禁止发起非法网络请求。

actions.action: Verify that the "网关地址" input field is visible on screen
Click the "网关地址" input field
Type "http://insecure.plain.http:8080" into the "网关地址" field
Verify that the field displays validation error stating HTTPS is required
Click the "网关地址" input field
Type "not-a-valid-url" into the "网关地址" field
Verify that the "连接至网关" button is disabled or blocks submission
Click the "网关地址" input field
Type "https://valid.gateway.local" into the "网关地址" field
Verify that leaving username or password empty prevents login
